sloka: एतानचिन्तयन् घोरानुत्पातान् समुपस्थितान्।निर्ययौ रावणो मोहाद्वधार्थी कालचोदितः ।। ६.९६.४० ।।
transliteration: etānacintayan ghorānutpātān samupasthitān।niryayau rāvaṇo mohādvadhārthī kālacoditaḥ ।। 6.96.40 ।।

translations.english: Intense battle took place between the angry Vanaras and Rakshasas challenging one another desiring victory.
